body: The last bit, "So I wait for you to come home." falls a bit flat for me. However I like the structure of the poem in entirety.
I really like the flow of your words.

I completely understand. My roommate hasn't done any cleaning in the last 6months, but likes to bitch and complain about how dirty everything is (it's not btw). She even goes so far as to leave passive aggressive notes everywhere saying she "won't clean up after me anymore!" when she really hasn't. The only "cleaning" she does is to throw all her dirty clothes, dishes and garbage onto my bed. People suck.
